gates.name: Pilot charter and participants
gates.evidence: Signed scope, named pilot users, authorised input classes and explicit pilot approval

gates.name: Private hosting and access boundary
gates.evidence: Approved environment architecture, private ingress and independent isolation assurance

gates.name: Production identity and role lifecycle
gates.evidence: Identity-provider configuration, MFA, membership lifecycle, session policy and role separation acceptance

gates.name: Tenant isolation and authorisation
gates.evidence: Synthetic role tests and revoked membership recovery; hosted controls not validated

gates.name: Evidence intake and parser assurance
gates.evidence: Approved isolated parser and scanning/quarantine process; operational assurance

gates.name: Encrypted storage and recovery
gates.evidence: Offline encrypted synthetic archive and in-memory recovery tests; hosted durable storage and managed keys open

gates.name: Retention and lifecycle
gates.evidence: Synthetic expiry check only; approved retention and deletion of hosted data/backups open

gates.name: Audit and operational response
gates.evidence: Audit chain verified on synthetic recovery; durable external audit and incident response open

gates.name: Privacy and stakeholder authority
gates.evidence: Approved privacy notices, consent/authority, minimisation, handling and deletion process

gates.name: Model governance
gates.evidence: Approved processing locality, model scope, reproducibility and human review assurance

gates.name: Scoring and assessor calibration
gates.evidence: Independent assessors, labelled cases, threshold/rounding/N/A decisions and acceptance

gates.name: Operational reliability and support
gates.evidence: Hosted backup/restore, monitoring, performance, rollback and recovery exercise

gates.name: Pilot UAT and go/no-go
gates.evidence: Authorised cohort, scenario acceptance, defect closure and separate signed go/no-go
